# axiom_label (Resource)

Manages an organization-level Axiom label. Reference its ID in dashboard, monitor, or dataset `labels` sets. Deleting a label also removes its assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "axiom_label" "production" {
  name        = "production"
  description = "Production resources"
  color       = "green"
}

resource "axiom_dataset" "logs" {
  name   = "production-logs"
  labels = [axiom_label.production.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Label name, unique within the organization (case-insensitive). Use single spaces between words and no leading or trailing whitespace.

### Optional

- `color` (String) Palette color: red, coral, orange, amber, yellow, lime, green, teal, blue, iris, purple, or pink. Defaults to blue; removing it resets the color to blue.
- `description` (String) Label description, up to 512 characters. Removing it clears the description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Label identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import axiom_label.production lbl_existing_label_id
```
